ValidationRule.description: #16068 : Sanctioned Accounts: Restrict Lead Conversion to Existing Sanctioned Account
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Converted_From_Lead__c = 'Converted', AND ( CONTAINS( TEXT(Type) , 'Sanctioned'), NOT(ISCHANGED (Type)), NOT(ISNEW()) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can not convert Lead to a Sanctioned Account.
